scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: 50 Jellopies and 20,000 zeny are all you need to get special effect on your green onion or carrot!

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: Enchant and reset have ^ff000030% of failure.^000000 Invest in your veggie and luck!
How much do I need to enchant?
Enchant to Poring Village Veggie
Reset Poring Village Veggie

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: As I heard, you can get Poring Village Green Onion or Carrot if you go west a bit more from here.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: I do enchant to the fresh vegetable.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: Enchant or Reset requires 20,000z and 50 Jellopy! It's not bad, is it?

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: Well... As you know, it's a vegetable any way. So sometimes it can be broken.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: Please put on the equipment you'd like to enchant first.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: This is not a vegetable!?

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: This vegetable cannot be enchanted anymore.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: This enchant requires 50 Jellopy and 20,000z..... But... you don't have them.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: Tada! Enchant is done! Check your vegetable.

scripts.speaker: Veggie Enchanter
scripts.text: It must have been a rotten vegetable. It's a shame that I can't stand this level of power...

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: Wow~ You look like a novice. I do want to adventure with you someday when you grow up!

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: Oh, now you are stronger than me. How did you grow so fast?

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: I should find another adventurer who is similar with my level. It's been nice knowing you.

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: My name is Emily. I was waiting for someone who will go on adventures with me!
Who said I will adventure with you?

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: Well, come one. Don't be stern. Listen, you can decide after listening to my story. Of course, I can give you a proper reward.
Proper Reward?
I'm not interested.

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: How square! It's much better to be together!

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: Yes! Proper Reward.

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: It seems this Poring Village can be defeated by beginners just like us. It's just a wild guess though...

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: Well, actually I cannot give you the reward officially through adventurer association. But we can separate the income after hunting.
But 50-50 sounds fair to me.

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: No way. 70-30. And I'm 70 of course.
It's gotta be 50-50 or it's no good

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: How about 60-40!!

scripts.speaker: Emily
scripts.text: This drives me crazy. OK, 50-50. Let's go with this.
